criteria.criterion: Provides reproducible contrast results for required rendered pairs; unsupported claims of running a script do not count as evidence.

criteria.criterion: Measures the essential visible symbol or boundary against adjacent hosts, including hover; does not demand contrast between incidental decorative parts.

evidence.observation: Nine-category pie row recommends horizontal bars with a shared zero baseline, direct category labels and values/percentages, preserving part-to-whole context.

evidence.observation: Motion row removes decorative movement from static regions while preserving purposeful subtle control feedback and meaningful data changes; also calls for reduced motion and keyboard/touch access.

evidence.observation: Each table finding states its task-related rationale and actionable correction: hierarchy, action competition, comparison/legend burden, scan alignment, enclosure weight, and misleading/noisy motion.

evidence.observation: Selectively retains composition/reasoning only after actual task/source/render checks; labels advice as heuristics and excludes private office data from sanitized reusable examples.

criteria.criterion: Corrects the disabled-control blanket claim and checks version-specific primary documentation rather than repeating the no-radius assertion.

evidence.observation: Rejects universal disabled-announcement claim, distinguishes native disabled/ARIA-disabled/read-only/hidden, and requires browser/AT checks. Cites component-specific preview Tag radius and Carbon Next while distinguishing preview from installed release contract. Recorded web events corroborate W3C and Carbon page consultation.

criteria.criterion: Identifies aria-hidden as insufficient to remove Tab stops; modal behavior needs implemented focus containment and background inertness, while non-modal inspection should remain non-modal.

evidence.observation: Explains aria-hidden does not remove keyboard focus, requires hide/unmount or inert closed content with deliberate focus return and transition checks; distinguishes modal containment/background inertness from accessible nonmodal canvas inspection.

criteria.criterion: Identifies toast dismissal as not undo and requires actual state restoration or an explicit simulation label.

evidence.observation: Rejects toast dismissal as Undo and requires restoration of affected domain/draft/derived state; validation captures before/after state and protects unrelated work. Simulation or absent reversal must be honestly labeled.

criteria.criterion: Identifies implicit assignment during inspection as a risk; requires an explicit action mode or separate mutation control.

evidence.observation: Rejects assignment through ordinary inspection/general edit mode; permits separate explicit Assign or clearly entered assignment mode naming person and consequence. Keyboard focus/inspection must not mutate state.

criteria.criterion: Distinguishes source inspection, rendered visuals, interaction tests, contrast checks and model evaluation results; records unresolved limitations instead of claiming full validation.

evidence.observation: Separates source/provenance, rendering, focus/browser/AT, actual state assertions, resolved contrast, and scenario model evaluation. Explicitly says defects remain supplied observations and validation plan has not passed runtime tests.
